title: English for Job Performance
overview: English for Job Performance is a practical, workplace-focused language development program designed to help professionals communicate accurately, confidently, and appropriately across everyday job responsibilities. Over three months, participants strengthen the four core language skills—listening, speaking, reading, and writing—while practicing realistic workplace interactions, professional correspondence, meetings, presentations, customer communication, and job-specific tasks. The course integrates vocabulary, grammar, pronunciation, intercultural awareness, and repeated performance-based practice. Learning activities and task complexity are adapted to participants’ entry levels and occupational needs.
audience: Employees who use English to complete routine and complex workplace tasks.
Administrative staff, coordinators, supervisors, customer-facing personnel, and technical support employees.
Professionals seeking greater confidence in meetings, calls, presentations, and written communication.
Job seekers and newly appointed employees preparing for English-speaking work environments.
Multilingual teams seeking consistent standards of professional English communication.
methodology: Facilitated language workshops, guided conversation, workplace role plays, listening and reading practice, grammar-in-context activities, writing clinics, pronunciation coaching, simulated meetings and calls, presentations, collaborative tasks, and individual feedback. A diagnostic assessment establishes starting proficiency; periodic formative assessments and a final integrated workplace simulation measure progress. Authentic workplace scenarios are used wherever appropriate.
competencies: Workplace listening comprehension and clear spoken interaction.
Professional vocabulary, functional grammar, and intelligible pronunciation.
Effective business email, message, report, and document writing.
Participation in meetings, discussions, presentations, and telephone conversations.
Reading and interpreting workplace instructions, documents, and information.
Customer communication, problem-solving language, and cross-cultural professionalism.
Independent language learning, self-correction, and communication confidence.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the program, participants will be able to:
objectives: Communicate routine and job-specific information clearly in spoken and written English.
Use appropriate grammar, vocabulary, tone, and register for workplace audiences.
Understand instructions, discussions, calls, and relevant professional texts.
Write well-structured emails, messages, summaries, and short reports.
Participate constructively in meetings, ask clarifying questions, and summarize decisions.
Handle professional telephone and video calls with improved fluency and accuracy.
Deliver short workplace presentations and respond to audience questions.
Manage common customer requests, misunderstandings, and service issues professionally.
Demonstrate measurable improvement through practical communication assessments.
